sentences.text: The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR. No. 225/2013, registered at Police Station Aman Vihar for the offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,1 as well as all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom.

This request is made in light of the amicable settlement reached between the parties, as evidenced by the Memorandum of Understanding executed on 8th April, 2025, between Petitioner No. 1 and Respondent No.2/
Complainant.
2. The Court has perused the aforesaid MoU and notes that, as per the terms of settlement, no monetary compensation has been provided to "IPC"
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 28/06/2025 at 00:15:44 Respondent No. 2.

The Court is not satisfied with Respondent No. 2's decision to waive of her right to claim such compensation, particularly considering that the marriage between the parties Ramesh Alias Kanhiya And Ors vs The State Nct Of Delhi And Ors on 30 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91955692/
1 subsisted for over five years prior to the grant of divorce.

sentences.text: This waiver may, in the opinion of the Court, stem from a possible lack of awareness on the part of Respondent No. 2 regarding her legal rights.

3. Accordingly, the Court appoints Ms. Ananya Luthra, Advocate (+91 98108-27926) as counsel, to represent the interests Respondent No. 2.
4.
Let a copy of the paperbook be supplied to Ms. Luthra.

5. List on 15th July, 2025.
SANJEEV NARULA, J MAY 30, 2025 nk
